text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":5,"unit":"scenes/day","kind":"count","span":"5 large-sized picture"},{"id":"q2","value":45,"unit":"scenes","kind":"count","span":"45 large-sized picture"},{"id":"q3","value":6,"unit":"scenes/day","kind":"count","span":"6 medium-sized picture"},{"id":"q4","value":36,"unit":"scenes","kind":"count","span":"36 medium-sized picture"},{"id":"q5","value":7,"unit":"scenes/day","kind":"count","span":"7 small-sized picture"},{"id":"q6","value":49,"unit":"scenes","kind":"count","span":"49 small-sized picture"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"days needed to draw all the large scenes"},{"op":"div","args":["q4","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"days needed to draw all the medium scenes"},{"op":"div","args":["q6","q5"],"out":"s3","note":"days needed to draw all the small scenes"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"combine large-scene days and medium-scene days"},{"op":"add","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"add small-scene days to get the total days"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total number of days to create all the picture scenes"},"dismissed":[]}
